tldr: the Sun through the 1st house brings attention to your body, identity, confidence, and first response to life.
body:
When the Sun moves through your 1st house, it brings attention to your body, identity, energy, appearance, confidence, and the way you show up. You may feel more aware of how you are coming across, how much energy you have, and whether your outer life still matches who you feel yourself becoming.

Something may feel more visible, energizing, exposed, or ready to be claimed. It can help you notice what needs more life, honesty, or direct attention.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for noticing what your presence is already saying before you explain anything.

The caution: Watch for needing validation so badly that you miss what actually feels true. The risk is becoming too focused on how you are perceived and missing what your body is telling you.

The Sun moves through this house for about a month. Use the visibility well. Put attention where it gives you more life, not just more approval.
